description: This file is the main React component 'App' for a notes management frontend application. It manages themes, notes state, loading state, and renders UI components for navigation, notes listing, editing, and authentication.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages the application state and UI rendering.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle between light and dark themes.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note and updates the notes list and selection.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note and updates the notes list and current selection.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves changes to the currently selected note and updates the notes list.
